field.label: Enable ctrld
field.help: Starts ctrld as the client-facing DNS listener on the interfaces configured below. Dnsmasq keeps running unchanged.

field.label: Log level
field.help: Verbosity of ctrld's own service log. info is a reasonable default; use debug when diagnosing routing/policy problems.

field.label: Local-zone resolver host
field.help: Address of the local resolver that *.in-addr.arpa reverse zones and the internal domain are delegated to -- normally Dnsmasq's own loopback DNS listener.

field.label: Local-zone resolver port
field.help: Port Dnsmasq's DNS component is listening on (Services > Dnsmasq DNS/DHCP > General). Checked against Dnsmasq's live configuration when available.

field.label: Enable caching
field.help: Caches resolved DNS responses in ctrld itself, for the duration of each record's own TTL. Recommended -- reduces upstream load and, combined with "Serve stale on failure" below, keeps already-seen names resolving through a brief upstream outage.

field.label: Cache size
field.help: Maximum number of cached records. 4096 is a reasonable default for a home/small-office network.

field.label: Cache TTL override
field.help: Leave at 0 to respect each record's own TTL. A positive value (seconds) caches every record for that long regardless of its real TTL.

field.label: Serve stale on failure
field.help: When an upstream is unreachable, keep answering already-cached names from the stale cache instead of failing outright, until the upstream comes back. Only takes effect while caching is enabled above.
